patthana18.21:1.1: saññojanaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no saññojano na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana18.21:2.1: ganthaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no gantho na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana18.21:3.1: oghaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noogho na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana18.21:4.1: yogaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no yogo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana18.21:5.1: nīvaraṇaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no nīvaraṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana18.21:6.1: noparāmāsaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na noparāmāso na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sārammaṇaduka hetuduke nasārammaṇaduka nahetudukaṃ
